package: CCT native C++20/CUDA Colab training package

sources.license: GFDL-1.3 and CC BY-SA 4.0 for original text, subject to Wikimedia terms and exceptions
sources.selection: first multistream shard; parse article text only; template/wiki markup is not claimed fully removed
sources.reproducibility: run.sh records retrieval URL, byte size, SHA-256, and retrieval timestamp; latest is a moving alias and must be pinned by the recorded hash for repeat experiments

sources.license: Apache-2.0 dataset repository metadata; inspect individual records and source terms before redistribution
sources.selection: English assistant messages, deleted=false, synthetic=false where fields exist; deterministic 80/10/10 split by stable message hash
sources.split_note: This package derives train/validation/test from the pinned ready-message export; it does not relabel the official Hugging Face train/validation Parquet splits.

evaluation.corpus: held-out deterministic Wikipedia text lines from the same declared shard; no training line is reused
evaluation.supervised: OASST-derived test split; training/validation/test identities are independently recorded
